source_search.result: No BPHS or other classical rule manual is present locally (see ashtakavarga_source.json :: source_search). No local text states Shadbala component formulas, minimums or Naisargika values with a citable edition/chapter/verse.

declared_source.source: docs/kundali/kundali_core.py :: shadbala() and its component helpers
declared_source.provenance_claim: PROJECT DATA, not an inspected classical edition. Cited to file and function. Weaker than an edition-and-verse citation, and labelled so.
declared_source.no_label_abuse: No formula in this project carries a 'traditional' or 'classical' label that is not backed by either a cited local source or an explicitly recorded convention. Conventions that vary between traditions are NAMED in the method matrix rather than presented as the single reading.

Uchcha Bala.note: Exaltation strength by distance from the exaltation degree.

Kendradi Bala.note: Angular strength from the whole-sign house.

Naisargika Bala.note: Fixed per-planet natural strength. PROVENANCE WEAKEST OF ALL COMPONENTS: these are classical constants but no local source states them, so they are frozen project data.

Cheshta Bala.source: kundali_core._paksha_bala(p, elong) where elong = norm360(moon - sun)
Cheshta Bala.note: Retrograde strength via paksha (angular separation from the Moon). CONVENTION NAMED: the elongation basis is stated in the docstring rather than presented as the only reading.

Saptavargaja Bala.scale: ALREADY RUPAS — must not be divided again
Saptavargaja Bala.note: The unit-mix trap: Saptavargaja enters the total as a Rupa figure. A previous error divided it again and drove every planet below its minimum.

Kala Bala.note: Computed in Rupas directly, not converted from Virupas.

Drik Bala.note: Reported as zero WITH a disclosure, not invented. Every Shadbala total in this project therefore omits the Drik correction, so a planet near its minimum is reported optimistically. This is a known, stated upward bias and must be carried into any interpretation that uses Shadbala.

unit_discipline_frozen.combination: total_rupas = (sum of the five Virupa components) / 60 + Saptavargaja + Kala
unit_discipline_frozen.drik: excluded from the sum; reported separately as 0.0 with disclosure

known_open_problems: No local source for any component formula, minimum, or the Naisargika table.
Saptavargaja and Kala conventions vary between traditions; the specific convention used here is named in the method matrix but not cited to an edition.
Drik Bala is absent, biasing totals upward near the minimum.
Cheshta Bala is computed through paksha; whether that matches the intended tradition is not established from a source.
next_required_work: Obtain a citable edition for the component formulas, the Naisargika constants and the per-planet minimums.
Implement Drik Bala, or continue reporting it as a disclosed zero.
Test each of the six components independently, as the instruction requires, rather than only the combined total.
